preconditions.description: u and v are integers within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) and x > 0 for x in return_value))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a list of positive integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' implies (len(return_value) > 0 and sum(return_value) == v and reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, return_value) == u)
postconditions.description: If a valid array exists, its length is greater than 0, its sum is v, and its bitwise XOR is u.
If no valid array exists, then either u is not 0 or v is not 0.
